home.metaDescription: I-Wakanze ixhumanisa abantu base-Afrika ne-diaspora yase-Afrika ngomlando, ijografi, isiko namathuba.
home.title: Isizwe esisodwa. Ilangabi elilodwa.
home.subtitle: I-Wakanze ixhumanisa abantu base-Afrika ne-diaspora ngomlando, ijografi, isiko namathuba. Buka amavidiyo ethu amasha bese ukhetha ukuthi ufuna ukubamba iqhaza kanjani.

memory.title: Umlando nenkumbulo
memory.body: Izindaba, imibhalo yomlando nenkumbulo yemindeni exoxa umlando wase-Afrika sisuka ngaphakathi.

culture.title: Isiko nabadali
culture.body: Ababhali, abaculi nabenzi bamafilimu ababumba isiko lase-Afrika nele-diaspora namuhla.

connection.title: Ukuxhumana namathuba
connection.body: Imicimbi nemibuthano yasendaweni eguqula i-diaspora ehlakazekile ibe yinethiwekhi.

home.storeBody: Izimpahla ezisemthethweni: isikibha nenkomishi ngayinye kusiza ukuxhasa iphrojekthi.
home.donateBody: I-Wakanze izimele. Umnikelo omncane usisiza ukuthi sishicilele, siqophe futhi sihlanganise abantu.

videos.title: Amavidiyo amasha
videos.intro: Amavidiyo amasha esiteshini se-Wakanze. Wabuke lapha noma ku-YouTube.

about.title: Indawo yedijithali yomphakathi womhlaba wase-Afrika
about.intro: I-Wakanze iphrojekthi yesikhathi eside yokuxhumanisa abantu base-Afrika ne-diaspora ngomlando, ijografi, isiko, ulwazi nezizukulwane.
about.body1: Umlando we-diaspora yase-Afrika akuyona nje indaba yokufuduswa. Futhi uyindaba yokudala: amasiko amasha, izilimi ezintsha, imiphakathi emisha kuwo wonke amazwekazi.
about.body2: I-Wakanze iqala ngento elula: indawo yokubuka lezo zindaba, yokuhlangana nabantu abazixoxayo nokuthola abanye abakhathalela izinto ezifanayo.
about.quote: Kusukela ku-diaspora yabantu ngabanye kuya kunethiwekhi yemiphakathi.
about.body3: Konke okunye, kusukela emibuthanweni yasendaweni kuya emfundweni nasemaphrojekthini ahlanganyelwe, kukhula kubantu abakhetha ukubamba iqhaza. Yingakho into yokuqala esikubuza yona ukuthi ungathanda ukuzibandakanya kanjani.

discover.title: Thola
discover.body: Buka amavidiyo ethu futhi ulandele i-Wakanze ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

connect.title: Hlala uxhumene
connect.body: Thola incwadi yezindaba enokuhle kakhulu kwenyanga ngayinye.

build.title: Yakhani ndawonye
build.body: Imibuthano yasendaweni namaphrojekthi kukhula kusukela lapho.

articles.title: Izindatshana
articles.intro: Umlando, isiko, umphakathi namathuba, ezakamuva kuqala.
articles.newsletterBody: Thola izindaba nemicimbi engcono kakhulu kanye ngenyanga.

events.title: Imicimbi ezayo
events.intro: Uhambo ngezinyawo, ama-workshop, izinkulumo nemihlangano, emadolobheni naku-inthanethi. Ukubhalisa kwenziwa ekhasini lomhleli ngamunye.
events.empty: Ayikho imicimbi ehambisana nalezi zihlungi. Zama izinsuku ezibanzi noma esinye isifunda.

supporters.title: Abantu abangemuva kwe-Wakanze
supporters.intro: Abadali namazwi asekela i-Wakanze futhi abelana ngokuqukethwe mayelana nomlando, isiko nempilo yase-Afrika neye-diaspora. Bathole ngesihloko noma ngezwe futhi ubalandele eziteshini zabo.
supporters.joinBody: Abasekeli bamenywa yithimba le-Wakanze. Uma udala okuqukethwe okuhlobene, sitshele ngomsebenzi wakho.

donate.title: Sisize sigcine ilangabi livutha
donate.intro: I-Wakanze ixhaswa yiminikelo kanye neSitolo se-Wakanze. Kokubili kusebenza ezinkundleni zangaphandle ezithembekile, ngakho awulokothi wabelane nathi ngemininingwane yokukhokha.
donate.giveBody: Wonke umnikelo usisiza ukuthi sishicilele izindaba, siqophe izingxoxo futhi sihlelele umphakathi imicimbi.
donate.shopBody: Gqoka ilogo ye-Wakanze ngokuziqhenya. Ingxenye ye-oda ngalinye iya kuphrojekthi.
donate.otherBody: Ukuvolontiya, ukwabelana ngokuqukethwe kwethu noma ukusitshela ukuthi ufuna ukubamba iqhaza kanjani kusiza ngokufanayo.

join.title: Ungathanda ukubamba iqhaza kanjani?
join.intro: Khetha okukodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ilungu lethimba lifunda yonke impendulo futhi likubuyele.

next.review: Uthola i-imeyili eqinisekisa ukuthi sitholile impendulo yakho.
next.contact: Othile ethimbeni uyayibuyekeza futhi axhumane nawe mathupha.
next.connect: Sikuxhumanisa nabantu abafanele, umcimbi noma umbuthano oseduze kwakho.

join.notMembership: Leli fomu lirekhoda intshisekelo yakho. Akusona isicelo sobulungu futhi alidali i-akhawunti.

member.title: Yiba yilungu
member.body: Yiba yingxenye ye-Wakanze njengoba ithatha isimo.

event.title: Ya emicimbini
event.body: Yiba ngowokuqala ukuzwa ngemicimbi esifundeni sakho.

interest.name: Igama eligcwele
interest.privacy: Le mininingwane siyisebenzisela kuphela ukukuphendula. Angayibona kuphela amalungu ethimba agunyaziwe, futhi ungasicela ukuthi siyisuse nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
interest.thanksBody: Siyitholile impendulo yakho futhi sithumele isiqinisekiso ku-{{email}}. Othile ethimbeni uzoxhumana nawe.

newsletter.note: I-imeyili eyodwa ngenyanga. Siqala ngokuthumela isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa, futhi ungazikhipha ngokuchofoza kanye.
newsletter.sentTo: Sithumele isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa ku-{{email}}. Chofoza kuso ukuze uqale ukuthola incwadi yezindaba.

cta.title: Hlala useduze nezindaba
cta.body: Izindaba namavidiyo amasha, kanye ngenyanga. Noma usitshele ukuthi ungathanda ukubamba iqhaza kanjani.

footer.mission: Sixhumanisa abantu base-Afrika ne-diaspora yase-Afrika ngomlando, ijografi, isiko namathuba.

confirmed.title: Usubhalisile
confirmed.body: Siyabonga ngokuqinisekisa. Incwadi yezindaba elandelayo izofika ekuqaleni kwenyanga ezayo.

unsubscribed.title: Usuzikhiphile ohlwini
unsubscribed.body: Ngeke usayithola incwadi yezindaba. Ungabhalisa futhi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kunoma yiliphi ikhasi.
